summary: Iteration 50: Complete testing of Personal Files feature (Личные файлы). Backend: 25/25 tests passed. Frontend: All features working correctly including password gate, folder CRUD, file upload via Cloudinary, file grid, preview modal, and search. Russian interface with dark theme (bg-slate-950).
seed_data_creation: Test files and folders created and cleaned up after testing. Pre-existing folder 'Фотографии' preserved.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Personal Files feature is fully operational. Key features verified: 1) Password gate at /admin/personal-files requires 'GenSutSu1999'. 2) Wrong password shows 401 error via API. 3) 'Личные файлы' link visible at bottom of admin profile page (/admin/profile). 4) Folders: GET /api/personal-files/folders returns folders with file_count. POST creates folder. PUT renames. DELETE removes folder and all files. 5) Files: POST /api/personal-files/upload stores file in Cloudinary. GET /api/personal-files/files supports folder_id and search params. DELETE removes file from DB and Cloudinary. 6) All endpoints require admin role (403 for non-admin). 7) UI shows file thumbnails, video play overlay, folder navigation with back button. 8) Preview modal shows enlarged image or video player. 9) Dark theme (bg-slate-950) applied correctly.
